What do you want to work on?

Six ways into the catalogue. The full programme descriptions live on SpainBcn.

AI and digital teaching

Digital tools and AI you can use for planning, materials and feedback, tried on your own lessons.

English and communication

Your own English, how you teach in it, and speaking in front of a room.

Spanish

Spanish in a small group, with the city and its history used as the material.

Inclusion and special needs

Teaching learners with special educational needs, and classrooms where a mixed group works.

Wellbeing and classroom practice

Staying well in a demanding job, and the routines that keep a class calm and learning.

Creative, outdoor and citizenship

Art, field work, sustainability and human rights as ways into other subjects.

See the Barcelona courses →

A typical course week

Classes run Monday to Friday mornings. You choose 20 or 25 hours a week when you book. Two afternoons are given to the week’s cultural activities, and someone from the team goes with the group.

See what a week looks like →

Bringing students?

Programmes can be built around your group’s dates, size and subject, in English or Spanish.

Plan a student group →

Barcelona, between sessions

The office is in Gràcia, five minutes on foot from the Sagrada Família, and classes also run at Barceloneta by the sea. Afternoons are yours unless the week’s cultural activity is on.

Practical information for your stay →

The people behind your week

Miriam coordinates the courses, Adriana handles the paperwork, and the trainers teach in their own subject areas. Participants meet the same small Barcelona team during the week.
